accent.note: Clean Bench preset (lib/palettes.ts 'clean-bench', 2026-11-09). Fills use accent-fill, which cuts 30% toward black on a dark palette; text keeps the lighter dark accent #6a93ff. Ramp: the canonical mixed toward black (0.4/0.6/0.8 of its value) and toward white (0.30/0.55/0.78/0.93).

blue.note: Drawn geometry and data only: the monogram's bowl, the gantt's secondary series.

paper.note: The pale grey-blue ground the tiles sit on; also on <html>.

ink.note: Headings and primary text; the ramp's start.

muted.note: Ink mixed 36% toward paper; the floor for text.

faint.note: Ink mixed 50% toward paper; lines and dots only.

on-accent.note: Text on accent-fill: whichever of paper or ink reads better.

scrim.note: Literal, because the lightbox portals to <body> outside .bp. The dialog scrim is ink at 45% with a 6px blur.

tint.note: Derived from the accent in lib/palette.ts. Chips, the active nav link, table heads, the contact card's left column, the Read more chip.

accentSoft.note: Derived from the accent. The bloom's main wash, the hero tile's glow, the calendar's first step.

accentFill.note: The accent as a surface; #4a67b3 in dark (30% toward black).

glow.note: Derived from the accent. The bloom's second wash.

narrative.overview: A bench of rounded white tiles on a pale grey-blue ground under a floating glass nav. The home page opens on a bento (the hero, the current role, where Riley is based, the degree, the GitHub calendar, this site, say hello), then reads as the resume at rest below it. One cobalt accent carries links, fills and active states; a soft blue bloom drifts behind the top of the page. Instrument Sans sets headings and body; Azeret Mono sets small labels. A project tile morphs into its dialog. Dark mode is the same bench with the lights down, where every fill cuts deeper.
keyCharacteristics: Everything sits on a tile: white, 22px radius, an ink hairline, a small shadow.
One blue in five jobs: tint, accent-soft, accent, accent-fill, glow.
One grotesque for names and sentences, a wide monospace for small notes only.
Rounded throughout: 10px inputs, 14px small tiles, 22px tiles and the dialog, pills for controls.
Frosted glass for anything that floats: the nav, the dialog bar, tags, floating controls.
One easing curve, one tile entrance, hover lifts of 1 to 3px, a full reduced-motion opt-out.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Colour is one hue in five jobs plus a deeper partner for geometry and data. No second hue reaches type or chrome.

rules.name: The Bloom-Stays-Blue Rule
rules.body: The bloom is built only from accent-soft, glow and tint at low opacity, drifts on a 22s cycle and holds still under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Deeper-in-the-Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode lightens the accent for text and darkens accent-fill for surfaces; new fills use --accent-fill.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Secondary tones and washes come from lib/palette.ts, never hand-picked.

rules.name: The Portal Rule
rules.body: Tokens are scoped to .bp; portals land in [data-bench-portal] or carry literal colours.

rules.name: The Hard-Copy Rule
rules.body: GanttChart.tsx, app/icon.svg, apple-icon.tsx and opengraph-image.tsx carry literal palette copies (ink #111318, accent #2457e6) and change by hand.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Small-Notes Rule
rules.body: Azeret Mono only for labels, dates, counts, tags and captions, never above 12px and never for a sentence.

rules.name: The Studio Roles Rule
rules.body: Four Studio font roles (header, sub-header, body, small labels) among ten preloaded faces.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover lifts are 1 to 3px and the shadow grows one step.

rules.name: The Everything-Is-A-Tile Rule
rules.body: Content is a tile or inside one, on the shared radius, border and shadow.

rules.name: The Morph-Not-Modal Rule
rules.body: A project grows out of the tile the visitor touched and collapses back into it; reduced motion gets a fade.

rules.name: The Resume-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: With every tile closed the home page is the resume, in order, readable without hover or animation.

dos: Do put every piece of content on a tile and every control in a pill.
Do use --accent-fill for painted surfaces and --accent for lines and text.
Do set labels, dates, counts and tags small in the mono.
Do keep the home page readable as the resume at rest.
Do open a project by morphing its tile and keep #project-<id> as its address.
Do lift 1 to 3px on hover with the one easing curve.
Do derive new colours from the seeds in lib/palette.ts.
Do add new copy as a Studio field.
donts: Don't introduce a second hue on type, chrome or the bloom.
Don't square a corner, drop a tile's border or zero its shadow.
Don't set a sentence in the mono.
Don't bring back the drafting grid, dashed frame or construction-line cover.
Don't open a dialog that ignores the tile it came from.
Don't pin, scroll-jack or trap the wheel.
Don't hand-pick a gray, a wash or a shadow colour.
Don't add a hero video, a marketing voice or an unbacked metric.
